summary: Frontend-only verification of new Apple-style /visual-agent-demo-next page. Page renders (not stuck on Suspense fallback), all required data-testids present, consent gate works, prompt chip populates the Doogie input via ez-doogie-ask CustomEvent, SSE assistant reply streams and renders (verified visually with rich markdown answer + source badge), listing-search query submits and starts rendering, and mobile 390px viewport shows zero horizontal overflow.

issues: Minor: Google Fonts preload console warnings (Inter/Playfair) — non-blocking but wastes bandwidth; consider removing unused <link rel=preload> or matching the actually-used font weights.

critical_code_review_comments: VisualAgentDemoNext.jsx cleanly reuses DoogieChat in embedded mode — good separation of concerns.

STARTERS -> ask() -> window CustomEvent('ez-doogie-ask') pattern works, but is a slightly loose contract; consider passing a callback prop into DoogieChat instead of relying on a global event for testability.

Assistant message bubbles do not appear to expose a stable `data-testid` (e.g. doogie-msg-<idx> or doogie-assistant-msg). Adding one would make future automated verification of streaming replies far more reliable — currently testers must fall back to text-content heuristics or screenshots.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The lazy chunk for VisualAgentDemoNext takes 3-6s to resolve behind the preview proxy — always wait for data-testid='visual-agent-next' with >=20s timeout before asserting render. Assistant message bubbles currently lack a dedicated data-testid, so verify streaming via visible text/screenshot or by counting `.hn-agent` chat elements rather than `[data-testid^="doogie-msg-"]`.
